lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: a whole trolley of vegetable baskets, and i tried every one. best way to spend a painting :)

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: real sky, baskets for days, nobody counting boxes. i'm never going back in that stockroom

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: sign held up all lunch. so did the treaty. day thirteen!!

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: oh... it's the menu i peeked at on my walk home. pork or prawns in every single basket

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: on her own celebration day?? i'm paying for the tea and we're going somewhere else

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: folding up the sign. mina, i'm so sorry

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: milk in the buns, butter in the tarts, milk in the pudding, milk in the TEA. the treaty is broken and my stomach has declared war

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: twelve days is still a record, roxy. we start the count again tomorrow

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: top shelf. i kept looking around for the yachts, and then the bill came and said i own one now

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: it's painting money, maya. let me cover your tea :)

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: great dumplings. zero windows. it's the stockroom all over again, just with soy sauce

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: last basket goes out on the steps. sky's right there, liam

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: lovely food, but it's so hushed in here that roxy's sign got a frown from the next table

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: honestly, i didn't mind the quiet :) but next time we find brooke her clatter

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: everything came out heavy and shining with oil. my poor post-cold stomach feels like it swallowed a brick

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: i'm walking you home the long way, brooke. sea air fixes everything
